name: Keycards
detailed_description:
Keycards – A Co-op Multiplayer Horror Experience

Trapped in darkness. Hunted by nightmares. The only way out? The right Keycard—if you can find it before they find you.

Keycards is a heart-pounding co-op multiplayer horror game where you and up to four friends must search for the correct keycard to escape terrifying, enclosed environments—all while being stalked by relentless, uniquely skilled villains. With randomized keycard locations, unpredictable enemy spawns, and limited resources, every playthrough is a pulse-racing test of survival, teamwork, and strategy. Distract the enemies to win.

With a wide variety of villains and powers, you and your friends must make use of the items you find along the way, such as health pills and stun grenades. Don't forget, you cannot kill the enemies! 

Only one keycard will unlock the exit door—your only hope for survival. As you search, horrifying villains roam the area, each with their own deadly abilities. You can only run, hide, and distract them long enough to escape.

Will you make it out, or will the darkness claim you?

Key Features

  • 5 Multiplayer Maps – Each with its own layout and challenges.

  • 10 Deadly Villains – Every round presents a new, unpredictable horror.

  • No Weapons, Just Wits – You can’t fight back. You can only distract and escape.

  • Co-op Survival – Teamwork is key, but you can also play alone.

  • Dynamic Suspense – Randomized enemy spawns and keycard locations make every match different.

  • Timed Mode – Escape before the clock runs out—or be trapped forever.

Add Keycards to your Steam Wishlist today!
